title: How a Butterfly Grows
text: A butterfly starts life as a small egg. The mother lays the egg on a green leaf. After a few days, a tiny caterpillar comes out. The caterpillar is very hungry. It eats and eats the leaf, and grows bigger and bigger. Then it makes a hard shell around itself. We call this shell a cocoon. The caterpillar rests inside for a long time. Slowly, it changes inside. At last, the shell opens, and a beautiful butterfly comes out! It has colorful wings. It flies up to the warm sun. Every butterfly was once a caterpillar. Growth takes time and patience.
translation: 蝴蝶的一生从一颗小小的卵开始。蝴蝶妈妈把卵产在一片绿叶上。几天后，一只小小的毛毛虫钻了出来。毛毛虫非常饿，它吃啊吃叶子，长得越来越大。然后它在自己周围做了一个硬壳，我们把这个壳叫做茧。毛毛虫在里面休息很长时间，慢慢地在里面发生变化。终于，壳打开了，一只美丽的蝴蝶飞了出来！它长着五彩的翅膀，飞向温暖的太阳。每一只蝴蝶都曾经是一只毛毛虫。成长需要时间和耐心。

words.example: The caterpillar ate the green leaf.
The bird lays eggs in the nest.
The caterpillar slept inside the cocoon.
